methods.label: Apply the tangency criterion
methods.explanation: Tangency criterion: A line that passes through the endpoint of a radius on the circle and is perpendicular to that radius is a tangent. Therefore, draw radius \(OA\) and prove \(OA\perp l\).
methods.levelReason: This is a direct application of the Grade 9 tangency criterion.
